displayName: Splunk Search Head - low dispatch disk space

conditions.displayName: Dispatch filesystem below 8 GiB for five minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "gce_instance" AND resource.labels.instance_id = "EXAMPLE_INSTANCE_ID" AND metric.type = "agent.googleapis.com/disk/bytes_used" AND metric.labels.device = "EXAMPLE_DEVICE" AND metric.labels.state = "free"
